FIELDS.NAME: Rapid Response Ambulance Services
FIELDS.FEIN OR SOC SEC #: REJECTED: Providers offering ancillary services such as body piercing, pharmacy dispensing, or cosmetic procedures are ineligible.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Rapid Response Ambulance Services specializes in providing emergency medical transport to hospitals and trauma centers, ensuring that all patients receive the highest standard of urgent care during transport. Our operations are managed by a team of certified EMTs and paramedics, all of whom hold current certifications and licenses, to guarantee qualified personnel deliver critical medical assistance. We maintain a modern fleet of ambulances that are regularly maintained and inspected according to applicable regulatory guidelines to ensure patient safety. Our dispatch services operate 24/7, allowing for immediate response to emergency calls. In compliance with legal requirements, we strictly document all patient transports and dispatch activities to ensure accuracy and accountability in our operations. Additionally, we have implemented a formal quality assurance program and incident reporting system, enabling us to continuously improve patient care and operational efficiency. Compliance with all relevant local, state, and federal guidelines is a top priority for us, ensuring we operate within established legal frameworks to maintain service excellence and avoid any unresolved regulatory violations.

Our ambulance and emergency services include providing essential medications and treatments during transport, which may involve dispensing pharmaceuticals to patients in critical need.

FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: The ambulance service reported three incidents over the past year. The first incident occurred on March 5, 2023, when the ambulance was involved in a minor collision while responding to an emergency. The cost of repairs amounted to $5,000, and this claim is currently resolved. The second incident took place on June 14, 2023, involving equipment damage during an emergency call, resulting in a loss of $10,000, which is still under review. Finally, on September 20, 2023, a patient transport resulted in a claim of $235,000 due to alleged negligence; this case is currently in litigation.

FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Rapid Response Ambulance Services does not offer any ancillary services that would involve catastrophe exposure beyond standard emergency medical transport. Our operations are focused solely on transporting patients to hospitals and trauma centers.
